definitions.explanation: A large piece of soft woven fabric used as a covering for warmth, especially on a bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{毛布|もうふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧もう⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧⟦{掛|か}けた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I put on another blanket because it was cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{毛布|もうふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: I borrowed a blanket on the airplane.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧{毛布|もうふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: Using an electric blanket keeps you warm.
examples.notes: ⟦{電気|でんき}{毛布|もうふ}→電気毛布：noentry⟧ = electric blanket

examples.english: I like wrapping myself in a blanket on the sofa and reading a book.
examples.notes: ⟦{毛布|もうふ}にくるまる→毛布にくるまる：noentry⟧ = to wrap oneself in a blanket

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{押|お}し{入|い}れ→押し入れ：01345_oshiire⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{毛布|もうふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧、⟦{洗|あら}ってから→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦{使|つか}うようにしている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Before winter comes, I take blankets out of the closet and wash them before using them.

notes:
{毛布|もうふ} refers specifically to a blanket — a single layer of soft fabric used for warmth. It is distinct from the Japanese bedding system that uses ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {毛布|もうふ}: blanket (single layer of fabric)
- ⟦{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}→掛け布団：07014_kakebuton⟧: duvet/comforter (thicker, filled bedding)
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧: futon (general term for Japanese bedding)
